entities.summary: Sho Kosugi (b. 1948-06-17, Tokyo) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tokyo and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, architects & designers, asia.
